notes.title: 『Crimzon Clover World EXplosion』＆『Castle of Shikigami 2』NOW AVAILABLE！
notes.content:
We've added two new SHMUP titles to the DEIGCA GAMES catalog, and we hope you will enjoy it! If you like SHMUP, then you shouldn't miss out!

『Crimzon Clover World EXplosion』 

After one year of its release on Nintendo Switch, "Crimzon Clover World EXplosion"  will be making its long-awaited debut on Steam!

★Price: $19.99 (10% off launch discount: $17.99)

★Special discount for 『WORLD IGNITION』 users 
If you have a copy of "Crimzon Clover WORLD IGNITION," you will automatically receive a 40% loyalty discount when you purchase "World EXplosion" during the following period. By adding up the launch discount, you can purchase "World EXplosion" at a maximum of "50%OFF." 

Take this chance to experience the best SHMUPS title! 

Special discount period: December 7, 2021 - June 7, 2022

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1718160/

▽Launch Trailer[previewyoutube=956XrCwP3RU;full][/previewyoutube]

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－ 

『Crimzon Clover World EXplosion - Complete Soundtrack』 

This soundtrack includes both the ORIGINAL and ARRANGED tracks of "Crimzon Clover World IGNITION"
※The contents are the same as the soundtrack for "WORLD IGNITION," so please be careful not to buy a duplicate if you already own it.

★Price: $7.99 (10% off launch discount: $7.19)

※Will be available soon※

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－ 

『Crimzon Clover World EXplosion ｰ Delux Bundle』

You can purchase the game and soundtrack all at once with a great bundle value. 

★Price: $25.18 (save $2.52 over purchasing them individually)

※Will be available soon※

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－ 

『Castle of Shikigami 2』

The second installment of the dramatic shooter that gained popularity in the arcades is now coming to Steam with +α elements!

★Price: $19.99 (10% off launch discount: $17.99)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1556650/
▽Launch Trailer[previewyoutube=-FFTKqaBoVs;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition to the game itself, there are some special items specially prepared for Shikigami fans!

『Castle of Shikigami - Series Bundle』

This is a special bundle (10% off) that includes "Castle of Shikigami" and "Castle of Shikigami 2". Customers who already own "Castle of Shikigami" will only have to pay for "Castle of Shikigami II", so you can save even more than usual!

▽If you own "Castle of Shikigami" and want to purchase "Castle of Shikigami 2"
$16.19 (save $3.8 over purchasing the game individually )

▽For new users who purchase both games at the same time
$26.98

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23980

『Castle of Shikigami 2 Soundtrack』

Not only does it include all of the arcade "NAOMI Sound Source Version", but it also includes the remixed "S2MIX Version"!

★Price：$6.99 (10% off launch discount: $6.29)

※Will be available soon※

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－

『Castle of Shikigami 2 - Collector's Edition』

You can purchase the game and soundtrack all at once with a great bundle value.

★Price：$26.98（save $3 over purchasing them individually）

※Will be available soon※

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－ 

『Castle of Shikigami 2』ｘ『RPG Maker MZ』 - Free Collab DLC

To commemorate the release of "Castle of Shikigami 2", a unique collaboration with "RPG Maker MZ" has been realized! Why don't you try recreating the story woven into the seven characters in "RPG Maker"? This DLC includes the following resources of the 7 main characters from "Castle of Shikigami 2".
Battler material
Face Material
Walking Sprites
Standing Image 
Extra: 4 BGMs from "Castle of Shikigami 2" in m4a/ogg format

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832590/  

－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－－ 

About『RPG Maker MZ』

RPG Maker MZ empowers you with simple tools to create your RPG right out of the box, yet is customizable enough to make the exact RPG you want! We are planning to update it to version 1.4.0 soon.
★ Points of Version 1.4.0
The editor will be able to handle data that is compatible with RPG Maker MV animations.
Improved performance of particle animation playback by updating Effekseer version.

notes.title: Shooting Love 20XX is Complete! EXZEAL is Now Available With Contest Being Held in Celebration!
notes.content:
Get EXZ-ited! Degica Games is pleased to announce that the fourth and final wave of Triangle Services’s Shooting Love 20XX, EXZEAL, is now available!...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/465060
To celebrate, we’re holding a contest!

EXZEAL Contest:
Details: This contest is to compete for the three highest scores in EXZEAL Remix, Stage 1 Score Attack on Hardest difficulty. You may select any of “Unit” weapon types. Make sure you are set to “Very Hard” difficulty with “Save Replays” set to “On” in “SETTING EXZEAL”. Replays must be submitted to be counted. Stage 1 Score Attack can easily be unlocked by completing Stage 1 in Arcade Mode. The three highest scoring individuals on the leaderboard at the deadline below will each win the Triangle Service OST (on Steam) of their choice!
 
Deadline:
The contest starts at EXZEAL’s launch, 7/14 US (7/15 Japan), and ends at 6pm PT on 7/21 in the US (10am on 7/22 in Japan).

EXZEAL is the fourth and final wave following the releases of the first wave, Shmups Skill Test...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/430290
...the second wave, MINUS ZERO...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/430300
...and the third wave, TRIZEAL Remix...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/465070/
With these four waves defeated, the Shooting Love 20XX collection is yours!
